WITH rating_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) AS across_rating_avg
  FROM rating_avgs
),
kept_ratings AS (
  SELECT avg_per_day_price
  FROM rating_avgs
  WHERE avg_per_day_price > (SELECT across_rating_avg FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_per_day_price) AS avg_per_day,
  AVG(avg_per_day_price) - (SELECT across_rating_avg FROM overall_avg) AS above_average
FROM kept_ratings

assumptions.assumption: At least one film rating has an average per-day rental price strictly above the across-rating average (if none exist, the result will be empty/NULL rather than omitted)
